title: MA61021: Mathematical Logic
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: voidProgramming Prolog - facts, simple queries, complex queries,
rules, arithmetic operators, recursion, unification, lists, cut. Propositional
logic - syntax, semantics, laws of deduction, normal forms, resolution, theorem
proving, validity, soundness and completeness. First order logic - conversion
of commonsense sentences into the language of first order logic, universal and
existential quantifiers, syntax, terms of predicate, model theoretic semantics,
Harbrand universe, normal form, unification, proof theory, mechanical theorem
proving, incompleteness.
